messages:
viv: heads-up  planning coordinated rollout tonight 23:30 UTC, need final pin + rollback map for api/runtime/console/router.

viv: proposed pins: api@3.6.1, runtime@3.1.0-κ, console@0.6.2, router@1.9.0. Canary waves: 1% -> 10% -> 100%.

omar: runtime note: 3.1.0-κ enables the new kernel selector. For canary set kernel_mode=conservative and batch_cap=32.

jin: rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >1.5% for 4m OR p95 latency increase >200ms for 4m OR KV eviction spike >9k/min. Immediate abort on OOM/disk>90%.

sre: agree. Add network egress spike and DNS errors as abort signals. On abort auto-fall back to api@3.5.x runtime@3.0.x router@1.8.x console@0.6.0.

infra: infra pre-warm +3 runtime nodes, autoscale buffer +25%, router drain 90s. I'll set short-circuit if router error-rate >1.2% for 2m.

viv: deploybot, schedule with abort hooks and attach runbook.

deploybot: acknowledged. Will publish job and post live updates here. Preflight checks passed.

viv: final thumbs? we'll keep replies minimal during the window.

omar: +1

jin: +1, staging green

sre: +1 oncall ready

infra: +1 infra green

deploybot: job scheduled: id=job-17234599, start=1723457400 (23:30 UTC), waves=[1,10,100], owner=@viv. Streaming to #eng-releases/deploy-logs.
